name: Introduction and overview — Mirage 2000 — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — Mirage 2000
description: Introduction and overview of the Mirage 2000: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The Mirage 2000 is a single-engine multirole fighter built by Dassault, entering service in 1984. Its tailless delta wing continued the Mirage tradition with fly-by-wire controls. About 600 were built, serving France and eight export customers; the type flew combat in the Gulf War, Balkans, Afghanistan, and Libya. Baseline facts: Single-engine delta-wing fighter; service from 1984; ~600 built by Dassault..
